Title: Azure Batch Transcription and Customization Rest API v2 will be retired by 29 February 2024

Body.Content:
We recently updated the Azure Batch Transcription and Customization Rest API to version 3. Version 3 builds on the capabilities of the previous version and the API layout aligns more closely with other Azure and Cognitive Services APIs so that you can apply your existing skills when using this speech API. With these enhancements, we’ll retire version 2 of Batch Transcription and Customization Rest API on 29 February 2024.

Action required

To avoid service interruptions, update your code that uses the Batch Transcription and Customization Rest API version 2 to version 3 by 29 February  2024.

More information

If you have questions, get answers from tech community experts from Microsoft Q&A. If you have a support plan and you need technical help, please create a support request.
